parts.text:
The speed of the ball just after striking the wall is less than its speed just before striking the wall.

State what this indicates about the nature of the collision of the ball with the wall.

stem:
A ball on horizontal ground is kicked towards a vertical wall. Fig. 2.1 shows the path of the ball.

{{figure:figure_2_1.png}}

Fig. 2.1 (not to scale)

The ball has an initial velocity $u$ at an angle of $38^\circ$ to the ground. The ball travels a horizontal distance of $9.0\text{ m}$ before striking the wall at a height $h$ above the ground. The horizontal component $u_{H}$ of the initial velocity of the ball is $9.5\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

Air resistance is negligible.
